Landing.headline: Build on a solid foundation
Landing.subtitle: Users, roles, and admin tools out of the box. Enable operator or end-user panels when you need them.
Landing.authDisabledBody: This project was generated without a login page. Enable Login page when scaffolding, or wire your own auth entry point.
Landing.featureUsers: Users and organizations ready on day one
Landing.featureRoles: Roles and permissions you can extend
Landing.featureReady: Operator and end-user panels when you need them
Landing.step1Body: Generate API, web, worker, and deploy folders with auth and roles already wired.
Landing.step2Body: Replace domain entities, forms, and landing copy — keep the motion and layout primitives.
Landing.step3Body: Publish with hardened JWT, CORS, health checks, and env sync for your VPS.
Landing.trustTitle: Built to plug into your stack

Operator.title: Operator panel
Operator.subtitle: Staff workspace for day-to-day operations. Customize this area for your domain.
Operator.orgsOptional: Organizations are optional — operators may work with or without an org assignment.
Operator.orgsRequired: Organizations are required — operators and supervisors should be assigned to an organization.
Operator.supervisorsOptional: Supervisor role is available for leads who oversee operators.
Operator.supervisorsRequired: Supervisors are required in the org hierarchy above operators.

UserPanel.title: My account
UserPanel.subtitle: End-user self-service area. Customize profile, preferences, and personal actions here.

Admin.title: Administration
Admin.subtitle: Manage users, roles, and organizations for this application.
Admin.usersBody: Add and manage accounts. Wire this screen to your API Users endpoints as you grow the product.
Admin.rolesBody: Roles are seeded from your generation options (Admin and Member always; Operator / Supervisor when enabled).

UiDistributionCenters.subtitle: Depots used as the starting point for driver routes. Map polygons still follow delivery stops only.
UiDistributionCenters.managerScopeHint: As a depot manager you only see and can edit your assigned distribution center. Supervisors add other depots.
UiDistributionCenters.empty: No distribution centers for this organization yet.

UiProfile.passwordHint: Only for accounts with a password (not OTP/Google-only).

UiMap.title: Planning map
UiMap.subtitle: Routes and stops for the selected fleet plan. Click empty map to add a stop; click a routed stop (when the plan is not confirmed) to select it for route edits.
UiMap.emptySelectOrgWindow: Select an organization and fleet plan.
UiMap.confirmedLockedHint: This fleet plan is confirmed and locked. Re-open it from the fleet plan wizard to edit routes and stops.
UiMap.emptyNoData: No data or choose another window.
UiMap.routesDesc: Shaded regions use the selected outline algorithm; lines follow stop sequence.
UiMap.noRoutes: No routes for this window yet.
UiMap.stopOverviewDesc: Summary of the stop selected on the map (visible as soon as the map loads).
UiMap.stopOverviewHintSelect: Click a routed stop on the map to see details here.
UiMap.stopOverviewLockedHint: This plan is confirmed. Re-open it to select stops on the map again.
UiMap.stopOverviewNoRoutesHint: Generate draft routes to see visit order and legs for each stop.
UiMap.routeInsightsDesc: Straight-line distance along visit order, shaded region area, and a rough time estimate (not turn-by-turn).
UiMap.routeInsightsFootnote: Region outline follows “{algorithm}”. Duration assumes ~32 km/h plus ~4 min service per stop.
UiMap.mapSidebarInsightsEmpty: No routes to measure yet. Generate draft routes first.
UiMap.mapSidebarOverviewEmpty: Load the map to see stop details here.
UiMap.mapSidebarEditsEmpty: Generate draft routes (plan not confirmed) to move, merge, or split visits.

convexHull.label: Convex hull
convexHull.description: Outermost polygon wrapping all stops—smooth and stable for sparse routes.

concaveHull.label: Concave hull
concaveHull.description: Tighter outline that follows clusters better than a plain convex hull.

boundingBox.label: Bounding rectangle
boundingBox.description: Axis-aligned box around stops—fast and easy to compare areas.

partitionNoOverlap.label: Partition (no overlap)
partitionNoOverlap.description: Convex outline per route, then trim overlaps in stable route order so shaded regions do not stack.

none.label: Routes only
none.description: Hide shaded regions; show sequence lines and stop markers only.

UiRouteEdit.title: Route edits
UiRouteEdit.subtitle: Pre-confirm only: move a visit, merge routes, or split a route from a chosen visit.
UiRouteEdit.lockedHint: This plan is confirmed. Re-open it to change routes.
UiRouteEdit.moveSectionHelp: Pick the visit (map click or list), then the target route. Sequence is updated on the server.
UiRouteEdit.mapSelectionHint: Using the stop selected on the map.
UiRouteEdit.mergeSectionHelp: All visits from the source route are appended to the target; the source route is removed.
UiRouteEdit.mergeResultDriverHelp: The surviving route is the target. You can pick a driver who was not checked under “Drivers included in this plan”; they still need a step‑2 fleet vehicle assignment. Unchecked drivers are listed first with a short tag.
UiRouteEdit.splitNewRouteDriverHelp: Tail visits move to a new draft route. Drivers not checked under “Drivers included in this plan” still appear here (listed first with a tag) if they have a step‑2 fleet assignment.
UiRouteEdit.pickDifferentTargetRoute: Choose a different target route than the visit’s current route.
UiRouteEdit.mergeRoutesMustDiffer: Source and target routes must differ.
UiRouteEdit.markerSelectHint: Click to select for route edit panel.
UiRouteEdit.splitDisabledFirst: Use the second stop or later as the start of the new route.
UiRouteEdit.splitDisabledLast: Pick an earlier visit so the original route keeps at least one stop.
UiRouteEdit.splitSectionHelp: This visit and all later visits move to a new draft route (same driver and vehicle).

UiRouteEdit.splitPickVisit: Select a visit where the new route should begin.
UiRouteEdit.stopPopupDragHint: Drag the large pin; coordinates save when you release.
UiRouteEdit.mapDragRepositionHint: Drag the pin to move this stop. Release to save new coordinates.
UiRouteEdit.removeFromRouteConfirm: Remove this stop from the route? It stays in the plan as unassigned.
UiRouteEdit.deleteStopConfirm: Permanently delete this delivery stop from the plan?
UiRouteEdit.editStopDialogDesc: Update fields and save. Route assignment is unchanged.

UiDriverPortal.homeCardVehiclesDesc: Add or edit your personal vehicles (plate, VIN, type). Turn vehicles active or inactive.
UiDriverPortal.profileSubtitle: Updates sync to your driver record and sign-in account.
UiDriverPortal.profileLoadError: Could not load driver profile. Ensure your account is linked to a driver.
UiDriverPortal.accountHelp: Email is your login identifier — contact a supervisor to change it.
UiDriverPortal.planningVehicleHelp: When enabled, draft route generation prefers your active personal vehicle if you added one below. Otherwise dispatch assigns an organization (fleet) vehicle.
UiDriverPortal.preferPersonalCheckbox: Prefer my personal vehicle for draft routes when available
UiDriverPortal.planningVehicleFootnote: Supervisors still assign fleet vehicles per shift; this setting only affects how planning chooses between your personal vehicle and those assignments.
UiDriverPortal.fleetAssignmentsHelp: Organization vehicles linked by your supervisor for planned routes.
UiDriverPortal.noFleetAssignments: No active fleet assignment — your supervisor can link you to an organization vehicle.
UiDriverPortal.vehiclesSubtitle: Personal vehicles are yours only; they appear in planning when the option above is enabled and the vehicle is active.
UiDriverPortal.vehiclesEmptyDesc: Add a vehicle to use it when you enable “prefer personal vehicle” for planning.

UiDriverPortal.historyNoRoutes: No route assigned to you in this plan yet.

UiDriverPortal.homeCardPackagesDesc: Recent package history you handled (scan / delivery), newest first.
UiDriverPortal.homeFleetBannerTitle: Managing drafts or organization-wide fleet plans?

UiDriverPortal.routesPageSubtitle: Routes assigned to you in driver portal. Filter by fleet plan or view all.
UiDriverPortal.packagesPageSubtitle: Packages where you were recorded as last handler (newest first, up to server limit).

UiPlanWorkflow.title: Fleet plan wizard
UiPlanWorkflow.subtitle: Step-by-step: create a one-day plan, assign drivers and vehicles, add deliveries, preview routes on the map, confirm, then download reports.

stepHints.0: Pick organization, service date, time zone, work plan template, and a distribution center (route start). Then create your fleet plan.
stepHints.1: Ensure each active driver has a vehicle assignment for route generation.
stepHints.2: Import Excel or add stops manually. Service date defaults to your plan day.
stepHints.3: Choose clustering strategy and polygon style, generate draft routes, then open the map to preview.
stepHints.4: Lock the plan when the preview matches what you want. Re-open here if you must adjust.
stepHints.5: Review counts and download fleet PDF, per-driver PDFs (ZIP), or JSON instructions.

UiGeocoding.hint: After you click the map, the address fills automatically when it’s empty. If you clear the address, it fills again from the pin. Edit the address and use Find coordinates to move the pin.
UiGeocoding.hintDeliveries: Leave either side blank: valid latitude/longitude fills address automatically after you pause typing; a non-empty address fills coordinates when lat/lng are missing or invalid. Uses Map.ir (MapIr:ApiKey).
